# `card`

Helper: `card({ title, sub, eyebrow, aside, v, tint, g }, ...kids)`, `panel(title, sub, aside, ...kids)`  
Kit (`src/ui`): `Card` (`card.tsx`) · status: src/ui  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaInfoCard` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Optional eyebrow, title (body-lg 700, heading), sub line (label 12), `aside` blocks on the right, then children.

## Variants

- `v`: panel (default), soft, ai, plain, flush, hero
- `tint`: info, brand, success, warning, danger or service 0-3
- `comp`: composition card (see ScheduleJobCard ... TemplateCard)

## States

- Static; the title takes the tint colour when tinted

## Tokens

surface, line, shadow-card, radius-card, field (soft), brand-50 (ai), heading

## Do

- Group one topic per card
- Put a table in `flush` so it touches the edges

## Don't

- Do not wrap every label in a card
- Do not nest cards more than once

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Padding 20 (hero 20/24, ai 18, soft 14).

## Mobile (390)

Panel padding 16.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Container. `tint`: a tone (`info brand success warning danger`) or a service number 0-3 (0 none, 1 brand, 2 success, 3 warning, as the old service cards S0-S3); title and headings take the tone colour. `v`: `panel` (default) `soft` `ai` (pale brand, "Pema AI · bản nháp") `plain` `flush` `hero` (patient card). `aside` = inline blocks on the header's right
